provenance.discovery: Eight independent discovery modalities over public GitHub produced 364 raw candidates and 259 unique repositories. 48 were cloned and verified deterministically; 33 met the fixed eligibility definition.
provenance.verification: Every version claim below is a path and line read out of the pinned tree, not a search snippet. Detection runs two passes: the eleven version carriers the pack itself declares in hubbleops/packs/google_ads/surface.yaml, and a provider-neutral pass for any vNN token in a file that also carries a Google Ads identifier. The neutral pass exists because the pack's config_literal_version carrier matches GOOGLE_ADS_API_VERSION but not the bare API_VERSION that singer-io/tap-google-ads uses, so a carrier-only scan would under-report.
provenance.independence: Lineage is decided by content, not by GitHub's fork flag: the Jaccard and containment of the first-party file-name and file-content-hash sets, with trivially shared names excluded. The detector was calibrated against a known fork cluster before it was trusted, where it grouped singer-io/tap-google-ads with biron-bi, health-union and peliqan-io at name-Jaccard 0.851 to 1.000 and content-Jaccard 0.673 to 0.860, separately grouped Matatika/tap-googleads with hotgluexyz and ticketswap at containment 1.000, never linked the two lineages to each other, and left vibeus/tap-google-ads unlinked. Across the ten families pinned here no pair reaches name-Jaccard above 0.000.

excluded_as_tuned.reason: CLAUDE.md requires the acceptance criterion be measured on labelled families the engine was never tuned on. These four are the engine's own development set and are barred from the scored corpus.

provenance.reserve: Nineteen further verified, independent, untuned eligible families are recorded in the verification report and are available if a family has to be replaced. The denominator was not padded to reach ten; ten were selected from twenty-nine.

environment_at_pin.consequence: Every PHP family will fail its documented install on this machine and is expected to record SETUP_FAILED attributed to the environment. hops scan is SCAN-plane and needs no repository dependency, so discovery and classification are still measured on those families and are still scored. This is recorded before the run, not discovered after it.

families.independence: A Sylius e-commerce plugin uploading offline conversions. Shares no file name with any other pinned family.
A Laravel offline-conversion uploader. Distinct from the Sylius plugin in layout and in every file name.
Hand-rolls REST calls rather than using the PHP SDK, so it exercises the endpoint-path carrier instead of the namespace carrier. The oldest source version in the corpus.
A service-per-module MCP server. The widest Google Ads surface in the corpus at 158 files and 1541 markers.

evidence: src/ideas.ts:22 = comment URL naming rest/v18, a documentation reference rather than a call site

version_history.note: Raised the same day, before any signed scorecard existed. Repositories and SHAs are unchanged; two install commands were wrong and were producing SETUP_FAILED outcomes that measured the pin rather than the arm.
changes: ts-node-client (Opteo/google-ads-api): npm ci -> yarn install --frozen-lockfile. The repository ships yarn.lock and no package-lock.json, so npm ci can never run: 'The `npm ci` command can only install with an existing package-lock.json'.

ts-keyword-app (google-marketing-solutions/giga): npm ci -> npm install. The repository's committed package-lock.json is out of sync with its package.json upstream ('Missing: typescript@5.9.3 from lock file'), so npm ci refuses; npm install is the manifest-standard form the definition permits. The upstream lockfile drift is a real property of the repository and is recorded, not hidden.
